_meta.description: Shared accept cases for the train request root syntax (REQ-39/#256). Each suffix is appended to the root placeholder /fandhe-edge-fixture-root (pytest appends it to str(tmp_path)) and the resulting request must be accepted by both crates/train (Rust) and trainer (Python). Names that merely contain '..' (e.g. ..b) need a real directory in Python and are covered by each language's unit tests instead.
